scene_resolution.main_map_rule: Last ACTIVE module with SceneObj/Main_map/scene.xscene wins (GetMainMapModule), then explicit module-qualified Read. Installed != enabled; do not infer active order from directory sort.
scene_resolution.resource_rule: Global texture/material/prefab names may collide across asset packages. Reused evidence identifies candidate names; package hash does not establish runtime winner or within-module package precedence.
required_runtime_guard: Record actual ordered active module IDs/versions/hashes for baseline launch.
Resolve target scene with explicit module ID; verify Scene.GetModulePath and scene-name/file hash before accepting fixture.
Reject unexpected enabled modules or duplicate fixture names rather than silently using name-only Read.
Pin global resource providers and inspect native override logs; module-qualified scene Read does not isolate global materials/prefabs.

navigation.meaning: Terrain face group is returned as TerrainType. Naval All combines naval-valid with wrapped base-model valid types. Names LandRestriction/SeaRestriction alone must not be interpreted as globally impassable; both pass the Naval predicate. Ship/depth/clearance/routing constraints are separate.
navigation.region_map: bool[max(TerrainType)+1], true for Default navigation. False is not itself proof of an impassable face. IDs invalid for All are disabled via SetAbilityOfFacesWithId before scene read.

crc-check-on-load.instruction: if xml or navmesh CRC differs from save: CalculateCachedValues + CheckPositionsForMapChangeAndUpdateIfNeeded on settlements/map events/armies/parties
crc-check-on-load.requirement: Loading a save against different scene bytes silently repositions entities.

region-map.requirement: bool[max(TerrainType)+1]; true where TerrainType valid for NavigationType.Default. Navmesh face group ids must be TerrainType values (GetFaceTerrainType returns FaceGroupIndex).

disable-unwalkable.requirement: Face ids invalid for all navigation types are disabled before Read.

main-map-module.instruction: foreach ModuleHelper.GetActiveModules(): if File.Exists(Path.Combine(FolderPath,"SceneObj","Main_map","scene.xscene")) result = module  (no break -> LAST match wins)
main-map-module.requirement: Main_map precedence is managed: last active module in launch order that has SceneObj/Main_map/scene.xscene. NavalDLC beats SandBox because it is later in the module list.

main-map-read.requirement: Scene name literal "Main_map" is hard-coded; module id comes from GetMainMapModule; LoadNavMesh/InitPhysicsWorld/InitFloraNodes stay true.

borders.requirement: Entities named border_min and border_max are mandatory; border_max.z is MapMaximumHeight.

atmosphere.requirement: atmosphere.xml in the scene folder (engine log shows .../SceneObj/Main_map/atmosphere.xml loaded after scene.xscene).

battle-index-map.instruction: MBMapScene.GetBattleSceneIndexMap(scene, ref byte[] map, ref w, ref h) [native IMBMapScene.GetBattleSceneIndexMapResolution/GetBattleSceneIndexMap]
battle-index-map.requirement: 2 bytes per texel: sceneIndex, packed normalized coords (4+4 bits); consumed only by MapScene.GetMapPatchAtPosition (managed). Native source is probably texture resource worldmap_battle_scene_grid (hypothesis).

snow-rain-wind.requirement: Only caller that allocates MapScene._snowAndRainData and _windFlowMapData (512*512*2 floats via Scene.GetWindFlowMapData). Without it GetSnowAmountAtPosition/GetRainAmountAtPosition/GetWindAtPosition index null arrays.

dynamic-snow-texture.requirement: Snow/rain per-pixel bytes come from a texture (resource main_map_snow_flowmap, also terrain attribute dynamic_flowmap_texture_name).

distance-cache-path.instruction: foreach active module: <ModuleHelper.GetModuleFullPath(id)>ModuleData/DistanceCaches/settlements_distance_cache_<Default|Naval|All>.bin, File.Exists, last match wins; missing -> FailedAssert + SandBoxNavigationCache.GenerateCacheData() (slow)
distance-cache-path.requirement: Distance caches are per MODULE, not per scene. Installed: SandBox Default; NavalDLC Default/Naval/All.

distance-cache-crc.instruction: ReadUInt32 x2 then GetSceneXmlCrc()/GetSceneNavigationMeshCrc() - all four results popped (never compared)
distance-cache-crc.requirement: Cache files are not validated against the scene; a stale cache is silently used.

derived_sources.bounds: Main_map border_min/max global frames; max.z supplies MapMaximumHeight; terrain extents come from nodes*nodeSize.
derived_sources.player_start: CultureObject.StartingPoint originates in culture XML start_point_position_x/y, with NavalDLC_SandBoxCore_SPCultures.xslt transformations also inventoried. CharacterCreationManager.ApplyFinalEffects tests navigation validity then uses closest valid face if needed. Clan initial_home_settlement and main hero faction are separate references; raw XML is not an asserted final loaded coordinate.
derived_sources.battle: Campaign.InitializeScenes loads each active module sp_battle_scenes.xml. MapScene.GetMapPatchAtPosition decodes native battle grid; DefaultSceneModel selects by map patch/isNavalEncounter with fallback. worldmap_battle_scene_grid is a candidate native texture source, not proven by managed IL alone.
derived_sources.weather: Scene atmosphere.xml; MapSnowAndRainDefiner prefab -> SnowAndRainTextureDefiner -> SetSnowAndRainDataWithDimension(texture,32). Global snow/flow resources are not scene-owned.
derived_sources.flow: Naval scene flowmap.dds and river_triangles.bin plus water_flowmap script/material names and global water resources. Native interpretation is not established by XML structure.
derived_sources.distance: Per ACTIVE module ModuleData/DistanceCaches/settlements_distance_cache_{Default,Naval,All}.bin; last existing match wins. NavigationCache.Deserialize reads and discards CRC pair; presence is not world compatibility validation.
derived_sources.mission_points: Representative mission/raid scene hierarchy names/tags/scripts included below. Prefab-internal spawn/exit points and actual usable routes require kit/native expansion and runtime baseline.

known_corrections_to_reused_evidence: Installed MapScene.Load uses CreateNewScene(false,true,...), not true,true in older map-scene-trace prose.
MapColorGradeManager is null-checked at MapScreen initialization; siege cache is not.
Naval terrain predicate accepts Lake/River/23/24/25 in addition to 10/18/19; sea semantics cannot be reduced to just three water IDs.
